summary: Iteration 92 — Validated the new per-center per-month GST Revenue Treatment toggle end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 unit tests pass (10 new test_gst_revenue_treatment + 5 AU + 4 India parser regressions, all green). 5/5 new API integration tests pass (test_gst_treatment_api.py): /get default=false, /set persists with updated_at+updated_by, /summary correctly switches operational_sustainability.revenue_share_base by exactly GST amount when flipped (verified delta = 42250.57 = GST), GST stays visible & non-zero in include mode, owner_share / revenue_share_amount increases by GST × owner_pct/100 (delta 6337.59 ≈ GST × 15%). Frontend: card renders correctly in Adjustments tab on PB-HSR/2025-12 with all 8 prescribed data-testids (gst-revenue-treatment-card, gst-card-gross-sales=₹9,91,876.00, gst-card-gst-collected=₹42,250.57, gst-card-commissions=₹0.00, gst-treatment-select with both options, gst-treatment-base-preview, gst-treatment-base-amount=₹9,49,625.43). All other Center Accounts tabs (Overview, MG Payout, Reports, Ledgers, Bundles, Adjustments) render without UI errors.

minor.issue: Review request states 'The payout block in /summary returned by compute_franchise_payout includes new field include_gst_in_revenue and gst_treatment_label'. The engine payload does include these fields (utils/financial_engine.py:232-237) but the /summary endpoint constructs the `payout` block separately (keys: type, amount, mg_amount, revenue_share_amount, ...) and does NOT propagate include_gst_in_revenue / gst_treatment_label into it. The fields ARE present on operational_sustainability, which is functionally sufficient — but the contract from the review is technically not met on the `payout` block. Functional impact: none (revenue_share_amount still updates correctly because it derives from the now-larger base).
